grh_d546b1d444daf1745843.title: Hizzoner Hamlet
paragraphs: Successful actor Ben Gamble abruptly quits his long-running television role because he wants to experience something real instead of living through scripts. A publicity opportunity makes him honorary mayor of a small town, where he discovers a genuine political fight between redevelopment-minded Mayor Brinniger and city attorney Brad Nelson, who says the mayor's plans hide corrupt land deals. Ben first treats the job like another part, then joins Nelson's effort to force the issue into public view. He deliberately lands in jail while his actress wife stages a public appearance that brings reporters and television crews to town, giving the corruption story the attention it lacked. After the political adventure is over, Ben admits that real life is harder and less entertaining than acting. His old series writes him back into the show as a ghost, and he happily returns to the studio.

grh_d552aef654bc7a1c6281.title: Audition Show
paragraphs: In this audition version of the Six Shooter story, a young masked robber steals money and shoots a man during his escape. The trail, the robber's age, and a distinctive horseshoe mark increasingly point toward Sheriff Ed's own son Ben, who has recently argued with his father over gambling debts. Ed continues the pursuit even as he struggles to believe his boy could have become a killer overnight. Britt corners the wounded fugitive at an isolated cabin and survives a gunfight; when the robber is finally seen clearly, he is not Ben, vindicating Ed's faith in his son.

grh_d5c490f4de7b2874f24b.title: Words at War 43-12-28 (29) Ninth Commandment - Invasion of Holland
paragraphs: A dramatization of Hendrik Willem van Loon's The Ninth Commandment follows Samuel, a devout Dutch picture-frame maker who takes in a German refugee boy before the war. Samuel punishes the child for lying, creating a grievance that resurfaces years later when the grown boy returns under Nazi occupation. Given a chance to save his own life by signing a false statement denying the old incident, Samuel refuses to bear false witness even against himself and is executed rather than violate the commandment he once taught the boy.

grh_d594ba98f8f4ecbefa71.title: Getting Drafted
paragraphs: During World War II, American war correspondent Hanley Finn is already working in New Guinea when he learns that he has somehow been drafted into the Army despite earlier being turned down for a commission. Sent through Brisbane for induction, he bounces through a comic maze of billets, dispensaries, ambulances and physical examinations because no one quite knows how to process a civilian who has already been overseas. After finally passing his physical, Finn unexpectedly receives a commission as a second lieutenant and emergency orders to Sixth Army headquarters. His new assignment sends him straight back to Finschhafen, the same New Guinea post where he first learned he had been drafted.

grh_d5976aa5f3e0c823756d.title: The Music Box
